response_type.description: chat: general conversation or agricultural knowledge, no action needed. recommended_action: user wants to know what to DO about a situation. farm_analysis: interpreting provided farm/sensor/camera data without recommending an action. tool_call: an available tool must be executed.

content.description: The main response for the user. Required (non-null, non-empty) for chat, recommended_action, and farm_analysis. Must be null ONLY for tool_call.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the key conclusion. Required (non-null, non-empty) for chat, recommended_action, and farm_analysis. Must be null ONLY for tool_call.

sources_used.description: Only RAG sources explicitly provided. Never invented. Empty if none provided or response_type is tool_call.

risk.description: Risk level of THIS specific recommendation. Every recommendation must carry its own risk — never omit this field.

risk_reason.description: Evidence/reasoning behind this recommendation's risk level.

recommended_actions.description: Populated ONLY when response_type is recommended_action. Each item is a single recommendation bundled with its own risk and risk_reason — there is no separate risk list. Empty array for all other response types.

tools.description: Populated ONLY when response_type is tool_call. Empty array for all other response types. Never invent a tool name.

$comment: Structural enforcement of the null/non-null content rule, so it does not depend solely on the model reading and obeying the prose instruction.
